title: 15 March 2015: Ringo Starr live at Pearl Concert Theater, Las Vegas, USA
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Pearl Concert Theater, part of the Palms Casino Resort in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, on 15 March 2015.

Just putting my jacket on and heading for Vegas for the last gig with the Allstarrrrrrs I love this band see you there Peace and love ?????

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) March 15, 2015

It was the 17th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between February and October 2015.

Starr previously performed at the Pearl Concert Theater on 22 and 23 November 2013.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion
